column8: 1=On, 2=On but in Restart Delay, 3=Off by I/O Key, 4=Off by Remote Shutdown, 5=Off by Remote Control
Bit 0 = Communications; Bit 1 = Local Off; Bit 2 = Remote Off; Bit 3 = High Head Pressure 1; Bit 5 = Loss of Airflow; Bit 7 = Change Filters; Bit 8 = High Temperature; Bit 9 = Low Temperature
Bit 0 = High Humidity; Bit 1 = Low Humidity; Bit 2 = Humidifier Problem; Bit 8 = Smoke Detected; Bit 9 = Loss of Water Flow
Bit 1 = Short Cycle; Bit 2 = Loss of Power; Bit 6 = Local Alarm 1; Bit 7 = Local Alarm 2; Bit 8 = High Water
Bit 0 - ON = Unit Off Bit 1 - ON = Unit On
